from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data for a single company from one filing period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as identified in the filing")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period in YYYY-MM format")
    retained_earnings_amount: float | None = Field(description="Retained earnings value; use negative sign if deficit")
    retained_earnings_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale for retained earnings: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    cash_and_equivalents_amount: float | None = Field(description="Cash and cash equivalents value")
    cash_and_equivalents_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale for cash: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    net_income_amount: float | None = Field(description="Consolidated net income value; use negative sign if loss")
    net_income_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale for net income: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financials: list[CompanyFinancialData]
